title: Arrival wave & standby procedures: AuroraTech April onsite
text:
Arrival wave & standby procedures: AuroraTech April onsite

["From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@auroratech.com>, TravelOps <travelops@auroratech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Arrival wave & standby procedures: AuroraTech April onsite

Hi Alicia / TravelOps team,

Quick note as we lock logistics for the April 19-20 workshop in Denver. We expect a concentrated arrival window the evening of April 18 (roughly 5:30pm–9:30pm local) for ~28 attendees plus three execs (VIP: Aurora CEO). Two asks we need to confirm by EOD Wednesday, Apr 7 so we can finalize manifests and send PNRs to the travelers:

1) Standby & cushion protocol: can Aurora provide a prioritized standby list for flights into DEN on Apr 18? If seats free up, we'd like to prioritize local product leads and the CEO backup (name in manifest). Also confirm the policy for confirmed rebookings vs. standby — we want automatic rebook to next available nonstop where possible.

2) Arrival wave handoff: who from Aurora TravelOps will meet flights between 6–10pm? Redwood will have two on-site coordinators (Marcus and Laura) but we need a named Aurora point-of-contact for gate/hotel transfers.

Attached is a working manifest (aurora_manifest_v1.csv) with current bookings and PNR placeholders. If your team can supply final PNRs and seat maps by Wednesday, we’ll run a seat-reassignment pass to cluster the execs and customers traveling together.

Also flagging one special request: Aurora CEO prefers an aisle seat in first available cabin and will require early check-in (hotel). Please mark that in the manifest.

Thanks — lmk if you want a short call tomorrow (15 min) to walk through the contingency steps.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
[Attachment: aurora_manifest_v1.csv (csv)]", 'From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@auroratech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, TravelOps <travelops@auroratech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -06:00
Subject: Re: Arrival wave & standby procedures: AuroraTech April onsite

Kimberly — thanks for the clear list. Quick updates from our side: 

• Standby list: attached is the prioritized standby CSV (pnr_changes_20270407.pdf) — we’ll push rebookings to the next nonstop if seat inventory opens. The travel desk is flagged to prioritize C-suite and product leads per your notes.

• On-site POC: Maria Torres (maria.torres@auroratech.com) will meet arrivals and coordinate shuttles; she’ll be on-site at DEN arrivals from 6pm–10:30pm on Apr 18. We’ll add her mobile to the sheet.

• VIP: CEO seat request noted; we secured aisle preference and pre-check-in with the hotel for early arrival.

I attached the updated PNR summary and we’ve included the final PNRs for 22 attendees; five are still pending confirmation. If Redwood can rebalance seating to group product leads together, that would be ideal — we left space in the seatmap column.

Call: Maria and I are available Thu Apr 8 at 9:30am PT for a quick run-through if that works.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Programs Manager, AuroraTech
agomez@auroratech.com
[Attachment: pnr_changes_20270407.pdf (pdf)]', 'From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <agomez@auroratech.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 07:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Arrival wave & standby procedures: AuroraTech April onsite

On Thu, Apr 8, 2027 at 11:08 Alicia Gomez <agomez@auroratech.com> wrote:
> Kimberly — thanks for the clear list. Quick updates from our side...

Thanks — saw the PNRs. I’ll take the seat-reassignment pass and try to cluster product folks into rows 12–16 (bulkhead forward) and push execs into 2–4. Two quick items: 

• If any of the pending five don’t confirm by Tue Apr 13, propose we use the standby cushion and move them to the next day’s redeye; that keeps the on-site schedule stable.
• There’s a potential last-minute request from our Exec team to upgrade one exhibit lead to business for health reasons — Kimberly, can you approve up to $420 for one one-way upgrade if needed? I’ll hold the hold codes until I get the green light.

Attached: updated manifest with seat clusters (arrival_meeting_roster.xlsx). I’ll update PNR columns after the seat pass.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Events Program Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
[Attachment: arrival_meeting_roster.xlsx (xlsx)]', 'From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@auroratech.com>, TravelOps <travelops@auroratech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Arrival wave & standby procedures: AuroraTech April onsite

Perfect — appreciate the fast turns, everyone. Quick confirmations and final asks: 

• Maria Torres confirmed as Aurora on-site POC (we added mobile to the sheet).
• Approved: Marcus may approve up to $420 for the one-way exec upgrade if medically indicated. Marcus, proceed and log the charge to event code AUR-2027.
• Standby policy: agreement noted — use prioritized standby list first, then auto-rebook to next available nonstop. Aurora TravelOps, please push final PNRs for the five pending by Tue Apr 13 5pm PT; if we don’t have them by then we’ll move them to standby and assign the next-day rebook as discussed.

Handoff plan for Apr 18 evening: Redwood team on-site (Marcus + Laura) will meet Maria at arrivals, coordinate shuttle manifests, and run a quick headcount at the convention hotel. I’ll be on stand-by and reachable on my mobile.

Link to live manifest & on-call numbers: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AuroraArrivalSheet (please don’t edit unless you’re the owner or the travel lead).

If any cancellations occur after Apr 13, please notify both Marcus and me immediately so we can release/claim seats.

Thanks — see you in Denver.

Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
[Attachment: aurora_manifest_v2.csv (csv)]']
